summary: A bowling-alley ball return: a rounded fibreglass hood with a domed top, an arched chrome-trimmed ball mouth… joints flap; options hood; sockets ball_slot_0, ball_slot_1, ball_slot_2, ball_slot_3, ball_slot_4, ball_mouth.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.bowling_ball_return or place "prefab": "bowling_ball_return" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
